meta_titel: TAX 28:28 — The simple tax system for the 21st century
meta_beschreibung: At most 28% on any income and a dividend every month. Municipalities decide for themselves; a common roof protects shared interests.
hero_h1: The simple tax system for the 21st century.
hero_sub: At most 28% on any income – and a dividend for everyone, every month. Municipalities decide for themselves; a common European roof protects shared interests.
stamp1_lbl: dividend per adult per month — {kind_2028} per child
stamp3_lbl: of people have more money in their pocket
prob_h2: Too complex to understand. Too full of holes to be fair.
prob_lede: Today's system has grown layer by layer. It burdens work more than anything else and leaves citizens and municipalities frustrated. Reference country: Germany.
prob1_h: taxes and contributions on an average wage
prob1_p: The average in Germany – the second-highest of all OECD countries. The OECD average is {keil_oecd}.
prob2_p: A euro earned from capital carries far less than a euro earned from work.
prob3_p: Municipality, district, state, federal government and EU. Money and tasks are shuffled back and forth; goals are missed.
prob4_p: Social contributions fall on human work only. Whoever replaces work with machines saves contributions.
prob_quellen: Sources: OECD, Taxing Wages 2025 (single person, average wage, 2024); German Income Tax Act, section 32d, plus solidarity surcharge.
konz_lede: Instead of five levels there are two. The municipality receives most of the money and decides for itself. A European roof takes on only what no municipality can do alone – and may not take more than the treaty allows.
svg_weiter: at least {mind} passes on to the municipality
div_p1: What we produce today rests on what generations before us built: knowledge, technology, infrastructure. More and more of it is done by machines and software. The dividend gives everyone an equal share of this jointly inherited progress – a return from the gains of automation.
div_p2: And it offsets what the transformation of work, energy and the economy asks of each of us: whoever has to change course does not stand empty-handed.
eff1_p: to manage their own money: one rate instead of a tax jungle, no special rules. A dividend every month, without application.
eff2_p: to run its own affairs: it receives fixed amounts per resident and per child. It decides on membership in districts and associations.
eff3_p: with what can only be done together: defence and digital sovereignty, a single market without borders, common standards. The roof decides by majority of its members.
fluss_lbl: Where {eur100} of taxes go each year
bau_lede: Every building block has already been tried somewhere in the world. TAX 28:28 joins them into a system that fits on a single page.
b1_h: Graduated rates with a firm ceiling
b1_p: Gross income is taxed – no deductions, no income splitting. The subsistence minimum stays tax-free; above it, work pays at every step.
b2_p: Work is no longer taxed twice. Countries that fund their welfare state from taxes do it this way – Denmark levies hardly any social contributions.
b3_p: Capital gains count too. Turning wages into capital income no longer pays.
b4_p: No exemptions. Whoever inherits a business or a house can defer the tax – nobody has to sell to pay it.
b5_p: Only the value of the plot counts, not the building. Whoever builds or renovates no longer pays for it. It may not be passed on to tenants.
b6_p: Wealth up to €2 million is untouched. Above it, a minimum tax applies that can be credited against income tax.
b7_p: This explicitly includes digital platforms. Profits can be shifted, customers cannot.
b8_p: Like an energy label, you see at a glance what a product costs and why.
b9_h: A carbon price returned to everyone
b9_r: European price path · returned via the dividend
b9_p: Those who consume little gain. Switzerland has been returning its CO₂ levy to everyone in equal shares for years.
b10_p: Adults in full, children half, no application. It is what remains after the tasks are paid – and it grows with the economy.
b11_r: guarantee of current benefits · hardship fund
b11_p: Whoever receives basic income support or student aid today (in Germany: Bürgergeld, Grundsicherung, BAföG) keeps at least the current level. The fund also covers housing costs, care and special circumstances.
rech_lede: What your household receives as a dividend, and what you pay in income tax under the new rates.
rech_fein: Rates applied to gross income without deductions. Dividend at 2028 prices.
gem_h2: Your municipality does its own sums
gem_lede: The whole distribution comes down to two numbers: {formel_einw} per resident and {formel_kind} per child per year. More children means more money for schools. And what the municipality saves on administration ends up with its citizens.
gem_verw: Administration's share of the municipal budget
gem_fein: Estonia's municipalities manage with {ee_verw}, Germany's need {de_verw}.
gem_plus_sub: more or less dividend per resident per month, depending on how lean the administration runs
zeit_h2: The dividend grows with the economy
zeit_lede: Until {tief_jahr}, old mistakes have to be mended: defence spending has been raised, and old debts must keep being serviced at higher interest. After that the dividend grows with the economy – and the debt melts away by itself: from {d0} to {d1} of economic output, without a single euro of repayment.
zeit_unit: Dividend per adult per month, euros at 2028 prices
sich_h2: Why the roof cannot grow out of bounds
sich_lede: A common roof is only as good as its limits. Five rules are written into the treaty.
sich1_p: The roof keeps at most {og} of what it collects – and only what its tasks really cost.
sich2_h: What is not needed flows through
sich2_p: Every euro above need goes to the municipalities and into the dividend. A limit that need not be used up never becomes an entitlement.
sich3_p: Municipalities receive fixed amounts per resident and per child. Nobody has to ask, nobody can cut.
sich4_p: The roof takes over interest payments and guarantees a common rate. Whoever brings more old debt evens this out over thirty years – the municipalities do not notice.
sich5_p: An alliance in which everyone has a veto cannot decide when the moment of decision comes.
erf_lede: Nothing in TAX 28:28 is a shot in the dark. Every building block is already running somewhere today – often for decades.
erf1_h: One rate, filed online in minutes
erf1_p: The tax return is done online in a few minutes. Property tax is based on land value alone; buildings are not taxed.
erf2_h: Strong municipalities, a welfare state funded by taxes
erf2_p: Municipalities run schools, care and social services. Social contributions play hardly any role – the welfare state is paid for by taxes.
erf3_h: A CO₂ levy returned to everyone
erf3_k: since 2008 · the same amount for everyone
erf3_p: Revenue from the CO₂ levy is returned to all residents in equal shares, credited against health insurance premiums. Municipalities set their own taxes.
erf4_p: Every resident receives a share of the common fund once a year, without a means test. For more than forty years.
klub_h2: A club with room to grow
klub_lede: The roof is not a closed circle but an offer. It has been calculated for ten countries – more than thirty in Europe are possible, and partners beyond. Choose for yourself: once it reaches the population of the United States, the club plays in the same league.
klub_uk_p: Not bound by the unanimity rule of the EU treaties: for the United Kingdom the club would be an accession, not a breach of treaty – and a way back into a common economic area. With {uk} million people, the second-largest partner.
klub_ca_p: Closely tied to Europe through the CETA trade agreement, and since 2025 through a security and defence partnership with the EU. {ca} million people, shared values, common tasks.
klub_6_p: Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain and Poland together match the population of the United States. Every further country makes the club stronger; none makes it impossible.
tl1_t: Concept and calculations are open. Experts, administrations and critics are invited.
tl2_t: Municipalities and regions find partners; countries consider joining.
tl3_t: At the earliest, after legislation and building up administration.
tl4_t: Every further country strengthens the club – above all in taxing where the customers are.
offen_h2: Developed in the open – get involved
offen_lede: TAX 28:28 is developed independently of parties and interest groups. Every figure comes from official statistics, every calculation can be checked, every error is corrected in the open. We are looking for experts in public finance, administration, local government, law and statistics.
offen1_d: The concept on two pages (in German).
offen2_d: All building blocks, figures and calculations (in German).
offen3_d: Calculations, data and logbook for experts.
offen4_d: Every objection is examined and answered.
